purpose: Fire log — one entry per challenge-generator firing. Records yield, not just occurrence: a generator is replayable while yield > commission cost. Saturation signals: contestants report no novel task, findings return zero new defects, quench returns zero convertible reds.

schema.generator: challenge generator id (koru-demonstration, koru-program, koru-quench, quirk-hunt, tighten, ...)

yield.pins_added: new test pins landed (red or green)
yield.novel: did the fire surface something new? true/false/partial

schema.note: one line — what the fire taught

fires.note: first replay, 3/3 pristine-green; catalog 0->5 (hanoi, crc, access-log, word-freq, mail-merge) + 800_010 deadbolt
replay #2 — 3/3 landed (kv_protocol, top_words, base64); catalog 5->8; first stateful session proof + first codec; 3 side findings gardened
first quench day — 12 reds converted (4 quirk-pins via argv-honesty, 4 via injected-env-machinery, 2 repins, 1 flip, 1 compiler fix); two new concepts gardened
8 findings stranded in worktree 3 weeks; judged+landed as red pins 310_145-152; all 8 quenched same day by quench-a/b
3 trees (dup-field walls, [parallel]for KORU212, store/index KORU161 gates); stranded a week unjudged — the seat's first salvage lesson
800_010 deadbolt won; switchyard + 800_013/014 judged losers evaporated 2026-11-03; last fired 10-11, unreplayed since

end_of_road.findings_generator: one fire returning zero new defects -> converge-check; two -> retired
end_of_road.quench: zero convertible reds -> standing; re-fires whenever the board grows reds
end_of_road.note: a catalog that stops growing has either achieved coverage or stopped asking hard questions — the log is how you tell which
